unquantifiable.m: Incapable of being quantified or precisely defined mathematically.

unquote.m: Used in speech to indicate the end of a quotation.

unquoted.m: Not quoted on the stock exchange.

unquotes.m: A form of unquote, as in “she unquotes”. unquote: used in speech to indicate the end of a quotation.

unquoting.m: The -ing form of unquote. unquote: used in speech to indicate the end of a quotation.
